simple.meaning: בַּרְזֶל (barzel) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “iron (as cutting); by extension, an iron implement.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 76 times across Genesis, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 16 more, beginning at Genesis 4:22. Its contexts include birth, family, death, kingship, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בַּרְזֶל (H1270).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: בַּרְזֶל (barzel) / H1270 is traced through Genesis 4:22, Leviticus 26:19, Numbers 31:22, Numbers 35:16 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H1270. barzel בַּרְזֶל noun masculine Deut 19:5 iron (with ל afform.; from piercing ? Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic id. , מַּדְזֶל , , Phoenician ברזל , Assyrian parzillu COT Gloss , (Arabic fetter is loan-word)) — always absolute ׳ב Gen 4:22 74t. ( בַּרְזֶל֑ 4:22 etc.); — 1 iron , literally: a. iron-ore, stone containing iron , Deut 8:9 ; Job 28:2 ; b. as raw material (to be worked) Gen 4:22 ; 1Chr 22:3 , 14 , 16 ; 29:2 (twice in verse); 29:7 ; 2Chr 2:6 ; 2:13 ; 24:12 ; Isa 44:12 ; c. as article of commerce Ezek 27:12 , 19 ; d. as material of furniture , utensils, implements, etc., ב ׳עֶרֶשׂ Deut 3:11 , ב ׳רֶכֶב Josh 17:16 , 18 ; Judg 1:19 ; 4:3 , 13 , ב ׳כְּלֵי Josh 6:19 , 24 compare 1Kin 6:7 ; Num 35:16 , ׳עֵטבֿ Job 19:24 & figurative Jer 17:1 , הַבּ ׳חֲרִצֵי 2Sam 12:31 = 1Chr 20:3 , הַבּ ׳מַגְזְרוֺת 2Sam 12:31 cutting instrument of iron , see Amos 1:3 , ב ׳כַּבְלֵי Psa 149:8 (|| זִקִּיִם ), ב ׳נֵשֶׁק Job 20:24 , ב ׳קַרְנֵי 1Kin 22:11 2Chr 18:10 , ב ׳קִיר & ב ׳מַחֲבַת Ezek 4:3 ; ב ׳בְּרִיחֵי , i.e. of Babylon, ag. Cyrus Isa 45:2 ; compare 1Sam 17:7 & Isa 60:17 (twice in verse) (figurative) 2 tool of iron Deut 27:5 ; Josh 8:31 ; Prov 27:17 (twice in verse); Eccl 10:10 ; Isa 10:34 (metaphor); head of an axe Deut 19:5 ; 2Kin 6:5-6 , so weapon 2Sam 23:7 ; Job 41:19 ; compare also Num 31:22 ; Josh 22:8 where iron as spoil of war. 3 iron in figure of unwatered earth Deut 28:23 ; of Egyptian bondage, הַבּ ׳כּוּר 4:20 ; 1Kin 8:51 ; Jer 11:4 ; of oppression ב ׳עֹל Deut 28:48 ; Jer 28:14 compare 28:13 ; of strength 15:12 (twice in verse); compare ׳ב מִנְעָלֶיךָ Deut 33:25 & Micah 4:13 ב ׳קֶרֶן ; of prophet, firm through Yahweh's might, ׳ב עַמּוּד Jer 1:18 ; of distress, ב ׳בְּרִיחֵי Psa 107:16 compare 107:10 of judgments of ׳י , & 105:18 ; ב ׳שֵׁבֶט 2:9 ; of evil-doers, Jer 6:28 ; Ezek 22:18 , 20 ; simile of scorching sky Lev 26:19 ; ב ׳מְטִיל of bones of hippopotamus Job 40:18 ; ב ׳גִּיד of obstinate neck of Israel Isa 48:4 .
